answer_1.quote: We provide crowdworkers with a short passage from Wikipedia and ask them to write five questions and highlight the span in the passage that best answers the question for each ... We use the fairseq implementation of BART Large, and finetune the decoder to generate questions conditioned on the passage and the answer highlighted by the annotator.

answer_2.quote: adversarial sampling selects generated questions in order of the least word‑overlap F1 scores when queried against the discriminative QA model ... uncertainty sampling ... selects generated questions in order of the least span selection confidence ... validated model error rate (vMER) is used as a metric of data effectiveness.

answer_4.quote: We validate all collected examples using a separate worker pool ... We ask three of these additional workers to report on the validity of each annotated example ... Fleiss' kappa at 0.46.
answer_4.guideline: workers report on the validity of each annotated example
